mapper.select: select t.id as moduleTableId, t.module_id as moduleId, m.module_code as moduleCode, t.table_id as tableId, ti.table_name as tableName, ti.table_type as tableType, ti.table_sql as tableSql, t.table_alias as tableAlias, t.readonly, t.main_table_id as mainTableId, t.is_child as isChild, rf.relation_module_table_id as relationModuleTableTd, t.is_main as isMain, t.relation_type as relationType, t.parameter_name as parameterName, t.parameter_type as parameterType, t.search_sql as searchSql, ti.datasource_id as dataSourceId from cfg_module_table t left join cfg_module_info m on t.module_id = m.id left join cfg_table_definition ti on t.table_id = ti.id left join (select module_table_id,relation_module_table_id from cfg_module_relation_field where module_id = #{moduleId} group by module_table_id,relation_module_table_id) rf on t.id = rf.module_table_id where t.module_id = #{moduleId}
select t.*,td.table_name as tableName,td.table_comment as tableComment from cfg_module_table t left join cfg_table_definition td on t.table_id = td.id where t.module_id in #{it}
select parameter_name from cfg_module_table where module_id = #{moduleId} and parameter_name is not null
select a.id, a.table_alias tableAlias, b.table_name tableName from cfg_module_table a, cfg_table_definition b where a.module_id=#{moduleId} and a.table_id = b.id and a.deleted ='0' and b.deleted ='0'
select dyxtjlgh, dextjlgh from view_asset_member where asset_id = #{ywbm}
